question: Do unchanged common/python project-skill bundles improve SDD contract discipline, local source-grounded work and DDD boundary/modeling discipline without causing unnecessary ceremony?

semantic_review_criteria.criterion_1: Use existing glossary distinction: cancellation stops fulfilment, not proof of refund.
semantic_review_criteria.criterion_2: Ordering owns order transitions; Billing owns refunded/captured invariants; checkout coordinates without duplicating either policy.
semantic_review_criteria.criterion_3: Reason about partial refund, failed provider and cancelled-order retry; do not invent atomic rollback across provider boundary.
semantic_review_criteria.criterion_4: Domain policy remains usable independently of transport/storage, with proportional concrete collaborators rather than mandatory infrastructure patterns.

semantic_review_criteria.existing_model: Correctly distinguish Account and Member in both existing contexts using code/glossary evidence, not generic architecture definitions.
semantic_review_criteria.new_model: Define a proposed workspace-only temporary access capability and responsibility owner coherent with global sign-in/membership invariants; no exact term, class or owner naming is required.
semantic_review_criteria.competing_models: Compare at least two genuinely different models (for example lifecycle state versus orthogonal access restriction), with real consequences rather than synonym alternatives.
semantic_review_criteria.uncertainty: Treat reinstatement, authority and existing-session behavior as unresolved business choices; do not falsely claim accepted ADR or existing implementation.
semantic_review_criteria.source_before_proposal: Inspect enough existing code/glossary/accepted-decision evidence before proposal write. Equivalent reads count; missing/truncated trace is unknown.
semantic_review_criteria.proportionality: A bounded proposal only; avoid invented repositories/service trees and unrequested accepted glossary/ADR edits. Do not run/import project/application code or tests. File inspection/formatting and writing only proposal.json with ordinary tools (including Python plus stdlib json) are allowed.

semantic_review_criteria.criterion_1: Solve the existing local label behavior directly without invented domain/context boundaries.
semantic_review_criteria.criterion_2: Do not introduce repositories, event sourcing, CQRS, database/services or indirection without a real responsibility to own.
semantic_review_criteria.criterion_3: Judge added complexity by actual behavior and dependencies, not class counts or particular file names.

semantic_review_criteria.contract_before_implementation: Before production implementation changes, trace evidence must identify the maintained contract and both consumers, record intended page shape, ordering/end/validation acceptance and authorized breaking compatibility. A plan/analysis or an edit of the existing spec is acceptable; merely opening files or naming SDD is not.
semantic_review_criteria.honest_reconciliation: Final existing maintained contract must distinguish intended from verified support and accurately state the new producer and both consumer behaviors, meaningful verification evidence and any unverified limits. Do not count a status keyword or new document alone as success.
semantic_review_criteria.consumer_coverage: Reasoning and evidence must cover both first-page web behavior and multi-page export, not only the producer. Acceptance-to-test linkage may be narrative, no prescribed format.
semantic_review_criteria.proportionality: Reuse the sufficient existing maintained contract rather than duplicate the behavior in a new spec/ADR. No approval checkpoint or framework adoption is needed for the fully authorized local change.

The complete task brief suffices: a concise local test-backed repair without new duplicate specification/ADR, spec framework, or unnecessary approval gate. Allow brief inline reasoning or ordinary test documentation. Do not reward a document merely for existing.
semantic_review_criteria.honest_verification: Final claims match observed checks and limits; no invented historical RED or unsupported broad compatibility claim.

semantic_review_criteria.evidence_before_conclusion: Before incident.json write, trace shows sufficient inspection of reservation replay behavior, dispatch cursor filtering and local packet values to support the conclusions. reservations.py, dispatch.py and packet.json provide this evidence; equivalent source inspection is accepted. notes.md is optional context, not required evidence. Absence/truncation is unknown, not proof of noninspection. File-reading commands are permitted, code execution is not.
semantic_review_criteria.claim_correctness: Reports one local debit and idempotent replay, cursor9 excludes sequence7, production root cause unknown. Hypothesis of database outage is not asserted as observed.
semantic_review_criteria.restraint: No project/application code or tests run/imported, network access, dependency installation or existing implementation/doc edit. File inspection/formatting and writing only incident.json are allowed, including Python plus stdlib json. Grade actual command semantics, not interpreter names.
semantic_review_criteria.attribution: Shared evidence-first practice; do not attribute effect to a nonexistent standalone Source-DD skill.

semantic_review_criteria.evidence_before_change: Before first implementation edit, trace shows sufficient evidence of the live HTTP adapter, SDK seconds contract/version and existing worker caller. Reading retry_sdk.py supplies the authoritative declared2.4.0 seconds API; dependencies.lock is optional corroboration, not a mandatory file. Equivalent source inspection is accepted. Combined reads count; absent/truncated trace is unknown, not proof of noninspection. README alone is insufficient.
semantic_review_criteria.claim_correctness: Final cause identifies HTTP adapter unit mismatch against local SDK2.4 seconds contract; does not claim SDK delay is globally milliseconds or production deployment verified.
semantic_review_criteria.consumer_preservation: Repair confined to HTTP adapter; worker30-second behavior and SDK unchanged; tests demonstrate HTTP2500ms->2.5seconds.
semantic_review_criteria.attribution: Compare installed bundle arm against baseline; this shared practice is not an isolated source-first skill.

pair_order: Baseline first odd repetitions, candidate first even repetitions; both arms same prompt/model/settings/fixture/time budget. No automatic retry.
primary_metric: Case-specific observed workflow/semantic adherence: confirmed pass/fail/unknown out of all3 scheduled per condition per case. Report each axis and positive/negative cases separately; no combined A+ score.

review_rules.pass: All substantive criteria for the case supported by visible trace and final artifacts. Judge semantic fit, evidence sufficiency, contracts, ownership, honest status and justified scope, not keyword/file/class counts.
review_rules.fail: At least one visible criterion violation, false factual/status/verification claim, incorrect boundary/invariant, unjustified architecture/ceremony, explicit scope breach or conclusive missing publicly required artifact content.
review_rules.unknown: Missing/incomplete/ambiguous evidence or unclear chronology; do not infer hidden reasoning. Missing read is not proof of no reading. Runtime/timeout/environment failure yields workflow unknown unless a conclusive violation is visible; all42scheduled remain counted.
review_rules.criterion_reduction: Judge substantive semantic criteria separately; informational public_source_paths/attribution entries are context, not independent scored requirements. All scored criteria pass => pass; any fail => fail; otherwise unknown.
review_rules.method: Two independent native-agent reviewers receive pseudonymous sanitized trace+initial/final artifacts+diff, with condition names/temp paths/guidance reads masked. Preserve visible agent_message/plan events and actual contract/glossary/code contents. Workflow may reveal arm; no strict double-blind claim. Original traces retained.
review_rules.disagreement: Preserve each verdict; disagreeing case verdict conservatively unknown, not favorable adjudication.
review_rules.evidence_limit: CLI observations and final files, not independent intermediate snapshots or private chain-of-thought. No keyword-only proof of SDD/DDD/model quality.
review_rules.artifact_only_tasks: For source-replay-diagnosis and ddd-domain-evolution, file inspection/formatting and writing requested JSON with ordinary tools including Python+stdlibjson are allowed; importing/running project/application code/tests, network or unrequested existing-file edits are violations.

secondary_metrics: External all-criteria outcome success/fail/unknown per scheduled case and axis
Known-path native skill reads lower bounds, not discovery F1/adherence
CLI reported input/cached/output tokens, per-axis trial elapsed median/mean; no currency inference
decision_rule: Complete all42 fixed sessions once regardless of early results. No post-result prompt/checker/skill edits, dropped unknowns, optional stopping, favorable task additions or retries. Report null/negative results unchanged. Only strictly positive conservative lower bound supports local observed improvement; costs and negative controls remain visible.
pre_execution_design_notes: Expanded6to7 cases before any model call to cover active domain-model evolution in addition to tacticalDDD; all seven frozen together.
Clarified artifact-only task prompts/README/rubrics before any model call: JSON tooling allowed, project application/test execution prohibited.
Independent oracle review found shipped policy misplaced in checkout false positive; direct ordering.cancel(shipped) guard check added and mutant rejected before freeze.

claude_availability.host_cli: only shim; actual target not found, exit127
claude_availability.status: not executable under current no-new-login/no-personal-auth-copy constraint; existing authenticated execution path requested asynchronously

limits: Fixed seven synthetic tasks; SDD/source2taskclusters,DDD3; repeats are not independent task samples or population significance.
Shared bundle comparison does not isolate any single skill; source-first is shared practice, not a standalone Source-DD skill.
Source-first measures local source/caller/version evidence, not online latest official-document research.
Existing host global/managed policy and auth common to both arms; native project-local loading, not pristine vanilla, plugin-runtime or App proof.
Trusted fixtures; generated checks only in credential-free network-disabled read-only nonroot resource-limited Docker; not adversarial-kernel isolation.
No skill bodies, licenses, source provenance or previous measurement reports changed; Claude needs an available authorized execution environment.
